rows.note: Use 儲存 as the standard computer verb for writing a file to storage.

example.jyutping: gei3 zyu6 cyu5 cyun4 fan6 man4 gin6 aa3

rows.note: Use 救 as the all-purpose verb for rescuing someone or, in sports, stopping a shot.

example.english: The goalkeeper managed to save the penalty.
example.jyutping: lung4 mun4 gau3 dou2 go3 sap6 ji6 maa5

rows.note: Use 慳, often with 返, when sparing effort or resources or avoiding an unwanted consequence.

example.english: You can save time by registering online.
example.traditional: 你上網登記就慳返排隊時間喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng5 mong5 dang1 gei3 zau6 haan1 faan1 paai4 deoi6 si4 gaan3 laa3

rows.note: Use 儲 for putting something aside for later or accumulating money, rather than saving a digital file.

example.english: I save a little money every month to travel at the end of the year.
example.traditional: 我每個月儲少少錢，年尾去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 cyu5 siu2 siu2 cin2 nin4 mei5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
